en: Black‑and‑white panoramic view of a rural European village in a hilly landscape. In the foreground are orchards divided by simple wooden fences. Behind them stand several farmhouses and barns with steep gabled roofs, timber‑framed upper stories, and plastered walls. More scattered houses and farm buildings extend into the middle distance, surrounded by trees and fields. Rolling hills and patchwork farmland form the background. There are no visible modern vehicles or infrastructure, giving the scene an early‑20th‑century appearance.
